summary: We are seeking an experienced Senior HR Business Partner to join our dynamic team in India. As a key member of the HR function, you will provide strategic HR support to our Software Products & Services business, driving business outcomes and employee engagement.
responsibilities: Partner with business leaders to develop and implement HR strategies that drive business growth and employee engagement
Provide expert HR advice on talent management, employee relations, and organizational development
Lead HR initiatives to improve employee experience, retention, and diversity & inclusion
Develop and implement employee engagement and retention strategies
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement business solutions
Analyze HR metrics and provide insights to inform business decisions

must_have: Master's degree in HR or related field
Minimum 8 years of experience in HR, with at least 3 years in a Business Partner role
Proven experience in HR Business Partnerships in the software industry
Strong knowledge of Indian labor laws and regulations
nice_to_have: Certifications like PHR, SPHR, or SHRM-CP
Experience with HRIS systems and analytics tools
Knowledge of diversity, equity, and inclusion practices

benefits: Comprehensive health insurance and wellness programs
Retirement savings plan with company match
Flexible work arrangements and remote work options
employment_notes: Note: The salary range is inclusive of all applicable deductions as per Indian tax laws. The company reserves the right to modify the salary range based on individual qualifications and experience. The selected candidate will be required to provide proof of identity and qualifications as per Indian employment laws.
